steps.content: June 20, N.F. 115
[Scene: Executive Committee]

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: We demand a thorough investigation into the drifters disrupting the mining agreement. This is clearly a coordinated attack, specifically premeditated to sabotage Nirvana—no, to sabotage the city-state's crucial project.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Do not test our patience. We are open to negotiation, but only under two conditions: full agreement on equity shares and profit distribution, and complete disclosure of the technical plans for Aurum Secretum's production capacity expansion. So far, Nirvana has avoided addressing either point.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: If you genuinely value the opportunities of the Great Expo, then come back to the table and directly address the core issues instead of using external distractions to pressure us. We expect sincerity. The people of the West District are watching.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Sincerity? The people? Haha, who appointed you as the people's voice? So a handful of stubborn traditionalists get to define "public opinion," while everyone else's voices don't count?

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Take a walk through the streets, and ask any Syndican with half a financial brain how much longer they're willing to put up with this charade of yours.
It's just that this time, they're not opposing Nirvana's heavy-handed pressure—

steps.speaker: Protesting Crowd
steps.content: No more delays to the development! West District can't wait! Open the mine! Cooperate for progress! Build our future today!!

steps.speaker: Protesting Crowd
steps.content: The Executive Committee must step aside! No more blocking negotiations for personal gain!!!
A moment's hesitation is all it takes for Matilda to miss her chance to counter. Her opponent immediately pounces on the opening.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Plenty of West District residents already hold Nirvana shares, which is proof we're sharing wealth opportunities. Meanwhile, you're the ones disrupting the labor union's work and standing in the way of real progress.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: The Great Expo is already underway, and Hypercube trade is absolutely critical—yet here you are, holding everything back. Let's be honest, aren't you just deliberately damaging our city-states' interests?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: This is...

Matilda can't definitively claim these protesters are all just vagrants hired by Nirvana to cause trouble. She recognizes that when faced with significant economic opportunities, no one can force people to sacrifice their livelihoods for some "higher cause." After all, everyone has the right to aspire to a better life, especially since the West District has suffered for so long—many truly need the money.
Max King bursts through the door, panting for breath.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Meeting adjourned! Meeting adjourned!! The protesters are storming the Committee building!! Everyone evacuate now!!

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Tch... Of all the times... Weren't they causing trouble in another district? How did they end up here?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Well, about that... haha, they kind of followed me here. I was trying to bring the sheriffs to smooth things over, but couldn't hold them back, haha.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Alright, if we don't move now, they'll really kick the door down! I've got cars ready outside. Everyone head back home for now. Let's continue this tomorrow!
The Nirvana representatives hesitate, reluctant to leave but knowing they have no other choice. They are the first to depart, but not before leaving a parting message for Matilda as they pass by her.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Hmph... The investment deal will be finalized before the Expo closes. You'll see.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: Everything will be settled at Parfait's dinner party, and you're not even worthy of a seat at that table.
With a scowl, he turns and walks away.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Get it done soon and don't let it disrupt the Expo. We still need to discuss cooperation with Fraser. Clear?

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: ...Speaker, your attitude sure changed fast. This is nothing like what you said before.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Well, sorry about that. The higher the seat, the wider the view—your position shapes your perspective. Nah I don't think you'll ever understand this. Now, do me a favor and get back to work, 'kay?
With a darkened expression, he carelessly gathers the scattered documents from the table, shoves them into Matilda's hands, and pushes her away.
As he passes by another West District representative, the latter remains silent for a long moment before finally speaking up.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ...For a negotiation this important, shouldn't the Speaker be present in person? Have you been excluded?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Huh?! Do you know what "Speaker" means? My words and leadership are already echoing through every corridor of power! There's no need for me to personally attend to every single matter.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: You fools... open your eyes! Nirvana is out there seducing everything with money and opportunities—the stock market is the ultimate casino! The tide has already shifted, and they're riding it straight to victory. Meanwhile, what do you have? How many allies can you possibly gain by nitpicking contract clauses all day? Wake up! Do you really believe you can win this fight alone?

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: ...You're right. We've been too naive. I'll change my approach. But I never imagined that after half a year, the Speaker of the City Council would still be standing alone.

steps.speaker: Samuel
steps.content: Where are your OWN allies, Mr. King?

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: ...The Speaker of the City Council's allies? It's the entire DisCity, of course! Now, enough of this. Go handle the situation outside before they turn chaos into catastrophe. I'm sure you do not want things to get even worse.
He smiles, and he has no choice but to keep smiling.
On the streets, the protests persist, but now, sharper voices are beginning to emerge from the crowd.

steps.speaker: Protesting Crowd
steps.content: The Executive Committee must step aside! No more blocking negotiations for personal gain!!!

steps.speaker: Protesting Crowd
steps.content: RESIGN! Cavendish OUT of the West District!! Rustfire BACK to the Drifter Camp!!
